new_nodes.label: Constant Bet Preserves the Unweighted Average Target
new_nodes.statement: For bounded adapted X_ij with conditional means mu_ij, a predictable empirical-Bernstein exponent with one frozen constant positive bet lambda_j over i has linear term N lambda_j (bar X_j - N^-1 sum_i mu_ij); varying bets instead generally target a weighted average when the conditional means differ.
new_nodes.domain: Finite N, one component j, X_ij in [0,1], predictable residual predictors in [0,1], constant lambda_j in (0,1), and the average conditional mean; no independence is required for this algebraic/martingale target identity.
new_nodes.scope: Finite N, one component j, X_ij in [0,1], predictable residual predictors in [0,1], constant lambda_j in (0,1), and the average conditional mean; no independence is required for this algebraic/martingale target identity.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Waudby-Smith and Ramdas predictable plug-in inequality plus an explicit constant-bet specialization to unequal conditional means.
new_nodes.proof: Replace the common conditional mean in each centered one-step factor by mu_ij. The one-step proof is unchanged. Constancy of lambda_j factors it from the sum, leaving the unweighted average conditional mean.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: With varying lambda_ij and unequal mu_ij the exponent controls a lambda-weighted target. Under dependence the average conditional mean can be random and is not silently a fixed superpopulation mean.

new_nodes.label: Frozen Constant-Bet Bounded-Martingale Coverage
new_nodes.statement: For m frozen bounded components, constant pilot-frozen bets lambda_j in (0,1), predictable predictors c_ij in [0,1], and L=log(2m/alpha), the W-scale intervals centered at bar W_j with half-width 2[L+g(lambda_j) sum_i(X_ij-c_ij)^2]/(N lambda_j) simultaneously cover all average conditional means with probability at least 1-alpha; for independent participant vectors these are exactly the R163 finite-design means.
new_nodes.domain: One fixed R161/R163 confirmatory plan, finite N and m, W_ij in [-1,1], pilot-frozen constant bets, predictable predictors, no same-confirmatory-data family selection, and independent participants for identification with the fixed R163 target.
new_nodes.scope: One fixed R161/R163 confirmatory plan, finite N and m, W_ij in [-1,1], pilot-frozen constant bets, predictable predictors, no same-confirmatory-data family selection, and independent participants for identification with the fixed R163 target.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Fan/Howard bounded exponential inequality, Waudby-Smith-Ramdas predictable plug-in construction, two-tail and m-component union bounds, and the R162 independent-pilot tower contract.
new_nodes.proof: Multiply the centered one-step exponential factors to obtain a nonnegative supermartingale, apply fixed-time Markov bounds to X and 1-X, union-bound two tails and m components, scale from X to W, and condition on every independent-pilot-selected plan.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Not uniformly narrower than Hoeffding; bad predictors or large residuals can widen it. Variable bets generally change the target. Participant dependence, same-data family selection or invalid range assumptions break the R163 finite-design specialization.

new_nodes.label: Rare-Spike Additive Protection Is Necessary
new_nodes.statement: For the R163 rare-spike law, any coordinatewise interval that excludes mean zero whenever a component has no spikes has m-component simultaneous coverage at most (1-.95^N)^m; at N=36,m=8 this is 0.2531673184308581, and controlling this event alone at familywise alpha=.05 requires N at least 99.
new_nodes.domain: The explicit independent m-component rare-spike product law and coordinatewise procedures having the stated all-no-spike exclusion property.
new_nodes.scope: The explicit independent m-component rare-spike product law and coordinatewise procedures having the stated all-no-spike exclusion property.
new_nodes.source_lineage: Exact probability calculation extending the R163 rare-spike witness; no general minimax optimality claim.
new_nodes.proof: A no-spike component occurs with probability .95^N and forces failure by hypothesis. Independent components give probability (1-.95^N)^m of avoiding all such failures; solving 1-(1-.95^N)^m<=.05 yields N>=99.
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: This is necessary only for procedures with the stated coordinatewise failure property and is not a sufficient sample-size theorem. Other spike counts can still cause failure.

new_nodes.label: Bounded-Martingale Missingness Endpoint Band
new_nodes.statement: When every bounded would-be outcome is well-defined, applying the frozen constant-bet theorem to all 2m lower/upper missingness endpoints with log(4m/alpha) gives simultaneous coverage of every all-enrollee finite-design mean, but leaves the support-identification width 2(1-bar R_j) unchanged.
new_nodes.domain: R163 well-defined would-be bounded outcomes, arbitrary observation indicators, independent participant records for fixed finite-design means, frozen endpoint bets/predictors, and no claim for physically undefined post-abort outcomes.
new_nodes.scope: R163 well-defined would-be bounded outcomes, arbitrary observation indicators, independent participant records for fixed finite-design means, frozen endpoint bets/predictors, and no claim for physically undefined post-abort outcomes.
new_nodes.source_lineage: R163 pointwise support endpoints plus R164 bounded-martingale endpoint coverage and a union bound over 2m endpoint means.
new_nodes.proof: Pointwise L_ij<=Y_ij<=U_ij. Simultaneously cover each endpoint mean with per-endpoint error alpha/(2m), then bracket the all-enrollee mean. Endpoint separation remains Ubar-Lbar=2(1-Rbar).
new_nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not point-identify MNAR outcomes, reduce the support width or define outcomes that a safety abort makes physically nonexistent.

new_rules.statement: The concrete bounded protocol, independent pilot-freeze contract, explicit finite-design target and constant-bet target-preservation lemma jointly yield finite-sample simultaneous bounded-martingale coverage for the exact R163 means.
new_rules.proof_sketch: Apply the one-step bounded exponential inequality with constant component bets, union-bound two tails and m components, identify average conditional means with finite-design means under participant independence, then use the pilot tower argument.

new_rules.statement: The fixed rare-spike witness yields an exact necessary obstruction for every coordinatewise procedure that excludes the mean on an all-no-spike component.
new_rules.proof_sketch: Compute the independent probability of avoiding every componentwise no-spike failure and solve the resulting familywise inequality.

new_rules.statement: R163 pointwise missingness endpoints and R164 endpoint-mean coverage jointly yield a variance-adaptive sampling layer without changing the arbitrary-missingness identification region.
new_rules.proof_sketch: Apply R164 separately to 2m endpoint variables at per-endpoint error alpha/(2m), union-bound, and retain the pointwise endpoint ordering and exact support width.
